stem.text: A small diesel engine uses a volume of $1.5 \times 10^{4}\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of fuel per hour to produce a useful power output of $40\,\text{kW}$. It may be assumed that $34\,\text{kJ}$ of energy is transferred to the engine when it uses $1.0\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of fuel.
What is the rate of transfer from the engine of energy that is wasted?
